rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a personal preference or liking.

example.english: I have a predilection for light flavours.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 cing1 daam6 hau2 mei6 jau5 pin1 hou3

rows.note: Use this when the predilection is expressed as a tendency or proclivity toward something rather than a simple liking.

example.english: Some people have a predilection for choosing spicy food.
example.traditional: 有啲人食嘢有傾向揀辣嘢。
example.jyutping: jau5 di1 jan4 sik6 je5 jau5 king1 hoeng3 gaan2 laat6 je5
